name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Either Frost goes with Robotics, or Mona goes with Chess — but not both.
Carver goes with at least one of Jonah, Chess, or Choir.
If Kira goes with Drama, then Mona goes with Choir.
Iris, Mona, and Noah go with Chess, Choir, and Scouts, in some order.
Either Jonah goes with Dunn or Ellis goes with Chess.
Kira goes with Chess if and only if Robotics does not go with Jonah.
Between Chess and Scouts, one goes with Dunn and the other with Iris.

hints.text: Suppose Iris went with Drama — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Iris goes with Drama.
Iris goes with Drama, so it can't also go with Chess.

So Iris does not go with Drama.
